title: Satwik-Chirag Face Malaysian Duo in Hong Kong Open Semifinal
indian_angle: India's former World No. 1 men's doubles pair, Satwik-Chirag, are competing in a significant semifinal match at the Hong Kong Open.
summary: India's former World No. 1 men's doubles pair, Satwik-Chirag, is set to face a challenging Malaysian duo in the Hong Kong Open 2026 semifinals, aiming for their third title this year.

title: Lakshya Sen, Satwik-Chirag Advance to Hong Kong Open Semifinals

title: Indian Teen Rakshitha Stuns Olympic Champion Chen Yu Fei
